title: The Most Racist Man Alive
summary: An episode of NH's long-running roast series on YouTuber Jason Blaha, responding to Blaha calling him a Nazi. NH contrasts Blaha's life with Alan Thrall's, then reads and rebuts passages from an old white-supremacist pamphlet and forum posts NH attributes to Blaha, ending with personal mockery of his physique and lifting.
claims: NH says Blaha has a roughly 1,300 lb total after 20 years of lifting, unchanged since 2014, despite drug use; teenagers reach that after about 2 years
NH cites Alan Thrall as a model: Marine veteran, gym owner, natural 350 bench, five-plate squat and 600 deadlift, later strongman, running and bodybuilding
Putting Nazi imagery in a thumbnail for a video critiquing fascism does not make the creator a Nazi
NH argues Blaha's ~13-inch arms after 20 years of steroids and lifting show failure at the one thing he devoted his life to
People who lift and work hard, like Alan Thrall, are loved for their character and effort; rejection follows a hateful character
